from manim import *
from manim.utils import scale

class GVERichScene(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.frame.set_size(20)

        sigmoid_text = Text("Sigmoid Function", font_size=40)
        sigmoid_equation = MathTex(r"\sigma(x) = \frac{1}{1+e^{-x}}")
        sigmoid_graph = FunctionGraph(lambda x: 1 / (1 + np.exp(-x)), x_range=[-10, 10], color=BLUE)

        self.play(Write(sigmoid_text))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(Write(sigmoid_equation))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(Write(sigmoid_graph))
        self.wait(2)

        self.play(Transform(sigmoid_text, Text("ReLU Function", font_size=40)))
        self.play(Transform(sigmoid_equation, MathTex(r"f(x) = \max(0, x)")))
        relu_graph = FunctionGraph(lambda x: np.maximum(0, x), x_range=[-10, 10], color=BLUE)
        self.play(Transform(sigmoid_graph, relu_graph))
        self.wait(2)

        self.play(Transform(sigmoid_text, Text("Tanh Function", font_size=40)))
        self.play(Transform(sigmoid_equation, MathTex(r"f(x) = \frac{e^x-e^{-x}}{e^x+e^{-x}}")))
        tanh_graph = FunctionGraph(lambda x: (np.exp(x) - np.exp(-x)) / (np.exp(x) + np.exp(-x)), x_range=[-10, 10], color=BLUE)
        self.play(Transform(sigmoid_graph, tanh_graph))
        self.wait(2)

        self.play(Transform(sigmoid_text, Text("Softmax Function", font_size=40)))
        self.play(Transform(sigmoid_equation, MathTex(r"f(x) = \frac{e^x}{\sum_{i=1}^n e^{x_i}}")))
        softmax_graph = FunctionGraph(lambda x: np.exp(x) / np.sum(np.exp(x)), x_range=[-10, 10], color=BLUE)
        self.play(Transform(sigmoid_graph, softmax_graph))
        self.wait(2)

        self.play(FadeOut(sigmoid_text), FadeOut(sigmoid_equation), FadeOut(sigmoid_graph))

        activation_functions_text = Text("Activation Functions", font_size=40)
        activation_functions_list = BulletedList(
            "Sigmoid",
            "ReLU",
            "Tanh",
            "Softmax",
            font_size=30
        ).arrange(DOWN)

        self.play(Write(activation_functions_text))
        self.play(Write(activation_functions_list))
        self.wait(3)

        self.play(FadeOut(activation_functions_text), FadeOut(activation_functions_list))

        camera_frame = self.camera.frame
        camera_frame.save_state()

        camera_frame.set_size(10)
        self.move_camera(location=[0, 0, 30])

        self.play(Restore(camera_frame))
        self.wait(1)

        self.play(FadeOut(self.mobjects))
